messages.subject: fvar unit tests
parts:

src/stan/agrad/rev/matrix/multiply.hpp:87:15:   instantiated from 'typename boost::enable_if_c<(boost::is_same<T1, stan::agrad::var>::value || boost::is_same<T2, stan::agrad::var>::value), Eigen::Matrix<stan::agrad::var, R1, C2> >::type stan::agrad::multiply(const Eigen::Matrix<T1, R1, C1>&, const Eigen::Matrix<T2, R2, C2>&) [with T1 = stan::agrad::var, int R1 = -0x00000000000000001, int C1 = -0x00000000000000001, T2 = stan::agrad::var, int R2 = -0x00000000000000001, int C2 = -0x00000000000000001, typename boost::enable_if_c<(boost::is_same<T1, stan::agrad::var>::value || boost::is_same<T2, stan::agrad::var>::value), Eigen::Matrix<stan::agrad::var, R1, C2> >::type = Eigen::Matrix<stan::agrad::var, -0x00000000000000001, -0x00000000000000001>]'
src/stan/agrad/fwd/matrix/determinant.hpp:37:7:   instantiated from 'stan::agrad::fvar<T> stan::agrad::determinant(const Eigen::Matrix<stan::agrad::fvar<T>, R, C>&) [with T = stan::agrad::var, int R = -0x00000000000000001, int C = -0x00000000000000001]'
src/test/agrad/fwd/matrix/determinant_test.cpp:42:47:   instantiated from here
src/stan/agrad/rev/matrix/dot_product.hpp:68:27: warning: comparison between signed and unsigned integer expressions [-Wsign-compare]
g++ -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.3 -I lib/boost_1.53.0 -Wall -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -Wno-unused-function -Wno-uninitialized   -c -O3 -DGTEST_USE_OWN_TR1_TUPLE -DGTEST_HAS_PTHREAD=0 -I lib/gtest_1.6.0/include -I lib/gtest_1.6.0 src/test/agrad/fwd/matrix/diag_matrix_test.cpp -o test/agrad/fwd/matrix/diag_matrix.o
g++ -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.3 -I lib/boost_1.53.0 -Wall -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -Wno-unused-function -Wno-uninitialized   -c -O3 -DGTEST_USE_OWN_TR1_TUPLE -DGTEST_HAS_PTHREAD=0 -I lib/gtest_1.6.0/include -I lib/gtest_1.6.0 src/test/agrad/fwd/matrix/diag_post_multiply_test.cpp -o test/agrad/fwd/matrix/diag_post_multiply.o

cc1plus.exe: out of memory allocating 4072 bytes
make: *** [test/agrad/fwd/matrix/determinant.o] Error 1

Does this mean that there is a memory leak?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] fvar unit tests
parts:
Daniel -- is there any way to give g++ more memory,
or does this mean it just sucked down the whole
machine's worth?

Peter --- this just means the templates were too much for
Windows to handle. It's a memory hog for complicated
templates. The only way we've gotten around this is to
keep the translation units simpler. We wound up having to
break some code into header and cpp and instantiation
files in gm/grammars and elsewhere w/o instantiations, and
we may have to do this again.

Or it may just be something we don't even want to
test on Windows right away.

- Bob
